translations.web: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.
translations.bsb: You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game.
translations.kjv: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.
translations.asv: Glorious art thou and excellent, From the mountains of prey.
